description: Four low-frequency oscillators, each giving a triangle and a square, with a logic section that combines them in pairs

params.text: Switched to HI that channel runs 0.05Hz to 87.5Hz; switched to LO it runs 0.00875Hz to 8.75Hz
Chooses which of that channel's two waveforms is fed to the logic section: the triangle or the square

inputs.text: Modulates that channel's rate, a tenth of a volt for each hundredth of the knob's travel, added to the knob and held inside its range

outputs.text: The lower of the two waveforms that pair sends to the logic section, taken sample by sample
The higher of the two waveforms that pair sends to the logic section, taken sample by sample
The difference between the higher and the lower of the two waveforms that pair sends to the logic section
The average of the two waveforms that pair sends to the logic section

notes: the panel marks the frequency input column with the maker's normalling arrow, but nothing normals those jacks: an unpatched one reads 0V and does not follow the channel above it.
which waveform a channel contributes to the logic section is set by that channel's triangle-or-square switch, and it is the same choice for the AND, OR, XOR and MIX outputs of its pair.
